label: Caramel-size (E90-1 American Caramel class)
size_source: PSA CardFacts: 1909-11 American Caramel E90-1 cards are each 1-1/2" by 2-3/4" — https://www.psacard.com/cardfacts/baseball-cards/1909-11-american-caramel-e90-1/113 (38.1×69.85 mm). This is close to, but not the same as, T206 (1-7/16×2-5/8). Do not merge the two guides. Other E-series caramel sets may differ — measure or source each set.
grader_notes: Same grader posture as tobacco-size: PSA/BGS/CGC/SGC yes; TAG no (undersize, pre-1989); ARS no.
